experiment_data.hypothesis: Confusability-aware batch composition (graph coloring on SCS matrix to separate high-SCS pairs) improves per-type accuracy and reduces substitution errors compared to random batching and single-pass full schema, providing a practical application of the confusability findings.

spec.description: Confusability-aware batch composition exp-018: compares graph-coloring batching (minimize intra-batch SCS) vs random batching (15 seeds for CI) vs single-pass 80-type baseline on FewRel 80-rel. 8 batches, 12 samples/type, 16320 total inferences.
